exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
Infants with unfavorable outcomes (severe intraventricular hemorrhage and early mortality)
resistive index (RI) from the anterior cerebral artery (ACA)
outcome: Resistive index (RI) from the anterior cerebral artery (ACA)
cohort: 96 preterm infants (<32 weeks of gestational age) admitted to a tertiary neonatal intensive care unit
finding: There was no association between ACA RI and Csat in the early period of life, but ACA RI values on the first postnatal day might be significant for predicting early mortality in very preterm infants.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by cesarean section had significantly higher ACA RI values on the first day of life than those delivered vaginally.
